title: Learning by Compression: Risk Estimates Attain the Law-of-Large-Numbers Rate
abstract: arXiv:2610.13442v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Compression schemes provide a general framework for deriving data-dependent risk bounds for learning algorithms. For learning rules based on preferent compression, existing results upper-bound the risk in terms of a sample-dependent complexity $\boldsymbol{k}$, defined as the cardinality of the compression augmented by the training examples on which the reconstructed hypothesis is inappropriate. These results, however, yield a margin of order $O(\sqrt{\ln N/N})$ above $\boldsymbol{k}/N$. In this paper, we establish that the logarithmic factor is not intrinsic. We prove that, for every fixed confidence level $1-\delta$, the risk is bounded with probability at least $1-\delta$ by $$ \frac{\boldsymbol{k}}{N} + O\left(\frac{1}{\sqrt{N}}\right), $$ uniformly over all possible values of $\boldsymbol{k}$. translated_title: 通过压缩学习：风险估计达到大数定律速率
translated_abstract: 压缩方案为推导学习算法的数据相关风险界提供了一个通用框架。对于基于优先压缩的学习规则，现有结果以一个样本相关的复杂度 $\boldsymbol{k}$ 来上界风险，该复杂度定义为压缩的基数再加上重构假设不适用的训练样本数量。然而，这些结果给出的裕量为 $\boldsymbol{k}/N$ 之上 $O(\sqrt{\ln N/N})$ 的量级。本文证明该对数因子并非内在固有。我们证明，对于每个固定的置信水平 $1-\delta$，风险以至少 $1-\delta$ 的概率被上界为 $$ \frac{\boldsymbol{k}}{N} + O\left(\frac{1}{\sqrt{N}}\right), $$ 且该界对所有可能的 $\boldsymbol{k}$ 值一致成立。因此，基于优先压缩的学习算法的风险估计达到了与经验估计相同的大数定律速率。
tldr: 本文证明基于优先压缩的学习算法的风险界中并非固有存在对数因子，其风险估计对所有复杂度取值一致地达到 $\boldsymbol{k}/N + O(1/\sqrt{N})$ 的大数定律速率，与经验估计速率相同。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that the logarithmic factor in existing risk bounds for preferent compression-based learning algorithms is not intrinsic, showing that risk estimates uniformly attain the law-of-large-numbers rate $\boldsymbol{k}/N + O(1/\sqrt{N})$, matching the rate of empirical estimates.
